ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two concentric circles, A is labeled above the outer circle, and K is labeled at the endpoint of the horizontal radius on the right side of the outer circle. The route indicated by the arrows sequentially includes: from A along the upper-left quarter arc of the outer circle to the leftmost point of the outer circle; then along the direction of the left horizontal radius from the outer circle to the inner circle; next along the lower-left quarter arc of the inner circle to the bottom of the inner circle; then along a vertical diameter of the inner circle from the bottom to the top; then along the upper-right quarter arc of the inner circle to the right side of the inner circle; finally along the direction of the horizontal radius from the inner circle to K on the outer circle. Reasoning: The radius of the outer circle is 20 meters, and the radius of the inner circle is 10 meters. The length of the quarter arc of the outer circle is (1/4)·2π·20 = 10π. The two quarter arcs of the inner circle together are half of the circumference of the inner circle, with length (1/2)·2π·10 = 10π. The two radial gaps are each 20 - 10 = 10 meters, totaling 20 meters. The length of the vertical diameter of the inner circle is 2·10 = 20 meters. Therefore the total distance is 10π + 10π + 10 + 20 + 10 = 20π + 40 meters.

raw_record.question_text: Two circles that share the same center have radii $10$ meters and $20$ meters. An aardvark runs along the path shown, starting at $A$ and ending at $K$. How many meters does the aardvark run?

method.method_draft: Directly decompose the shown path into its visible pieces. From the image, read the aardvark's route as: a quarter-circle arc on the outer circle from A at the top to the leftmost point; a straight radial segment from the outer circle to the inner circle on the left; a quarter-circle arc on the inner circle from the leftmost point to the bottom; a straight vertical diameter of the inner circle from bottom to top; another quarter-circle arc on the inner circle from the top to the rightmost point; and a straight radial segment from the inner circle to K on the outer circle. From the text, use the radii 20 m for the outer circle and 10 m for the inner circle. Compute arc lengths: outer quarter arc is one-fourth of circumference 2π(20), giving 10π; the two inner quarter arcs together are one-half of circumference 2π(10), giving 10π. Compute straight lengths: each radial gap is 20−10=10, and the inner vertical diameter is 2(10)=20. Total distance is 10π+10π+10+20+10=20π+40.

推理：外圆半径为 20 米，内圆半径为 10 米。外圆四分之一圆弧长度为 (1/4)·2π·20 = 10π。两段内圆四分之一圆弧合起来是半个内圆周长，长度为 (1/2)·2π·10 = 10π。两段径向间隔各为 20 - 10 = 10 米，共 20 米。内圆竖直直径长度为 2·10 = 20 米。因此总路程为 10π + 10π + 10 + 20 + 10 = 20π + 40 米。
